title: Brazilian Cucumber Salad
description: A refreshing and light salad made with cucumber, crunchy elements, and a hint of Brazilian spices. Perfect for a warm day.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine sliced cucumber, cubed yeasty bread, and chopped crunchy elements.
In a small bowl, whisk together Brazilian spice blend, olive oil, and lemon juice.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Serve chilled, garnished with additional chopped nuts or seeds if desired.
